about: Menu research for Senso Café & Bites (Kian via the PM, 2026-10-12): every item shown on the page that day. Descriptions where the field was empty (newEn, newFa; null = the venue's own text stays), and the allergen and dietary drafts with their basis (the assumed key ingredients and a source for the dish type, from simple web research). Drafts only: allergens and dietary words are never on the public page until an owner or admin confirms them; the descriptions are shown and marked as drafts in the admin. Applied by tools/import/research-apply.mjs (also in npm run setup); reviewed in reports/research-review-senso.csv. Rules: research-report.md beside this file.
edits: Falooda: the noodles are starch noodles (the text said "noodles", which reads as wheat pasta); wheat kept as a precaution until the kitchen confirms the starch
Greek Salad: a draft must not miss an allergen the typical recipe carries; the owner removes it if the kitchen serves it without feta

Kian, 2026-10-13: Senso Waffle: placeholder descriptions withdrawn (cleared where still the research's draft; allergen drafts kept); every contradiction carries a proposed fix, applied only when its row is ticked in the review sheet
